item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 25/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the upper-air disturbances departing, showers will ease off and the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. A trough of low pressure is expected to develop gradually and edge closer to the coastal areas of southern China early to midweek next week. The weather will become unsettled over the region. The northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region.
